description: This Java source file defines the ArtifactInfoFactory class, which manages and provides access to various artifact information objects (entities, services, forms, screens, controllers) within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for loading, caching, and retrieving artifact metadata, as well as preparing analysis tasks for components and services.

classes.name: ArtifactInfoFactory
classes.description: Factory class for managing and retrieving artifact information objects such as entities, services, forms, screens, and controllers within the OFBiz framework. Handles caching, loading, and analysis task preparation.

methods.name: getArtifactInfoFactory
methods.description: Retrieves a singleton instance of ArtifactInfoFactory for a given delegator name, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: prepareAll
methods.description: Loads and initializes all artifact info objects, including entities, services, and components, using concurrent execution.

methods.name: getEntityArtifactInfo
methods.description: Returns the EntityArtifactInfo object for a given entity name, creating and populating it if not already cached.

methods.name: getServiceArtifactInfo
methods.description: Returns the ServiceArtifactInfo object for a given service name, creating and populating it if not already cached.

methods.name: getFormWidgetArtifactInfo
methods.description: Returns the FormWidgetArtifactInfo for specified form name and location, creating and populating if needed.

methods.name: getScreenWidgetArtifactInfo
methods.description: Returns the ScreenWidgetArtifactInfo for specified screen name and location, creating and populating if needed.

methods.name: getControllerRequestArtifactInfo
methods.description: Returns the ControllerRequestArtifactInfo for specified controller URL and request URI, creating and populating if needed.

methods.name: getControllerViewArtifactInfo
methods.description: Returns the ControllerViewArtifactInfo for specified controller URL and view URI, creating if needed.

methods.name: getArtifactInfoByUniqueIdAndType
methods.description: Retrieves an artifact info object based on its unique ID and type.

methods.name: getArtifactInfoByNameAndType
methods.description: Retrieves an artifact info object based on its name, location, and type.

methods.name: getAllArtifactInfosByNamePartial
methods.description: Returns a set of artifact info objects whose names partially match the given string, filtered by type.
